title: Vendor Gateway: pricing-bundles experiment + SOC2 evidence handshake
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a vendor-facing onboarding gateway that couples a set of pricing/packaging experiments (bundle configurations and insurance crediting) with an automated SOC2 evidence handshake to reduce procurement friction for enterprise customers. The goal is to enable self-serve procurement for second-tier enterprise deals while surfacing needed legal/finance guardrails and collecting verifiable evidence for SOC2/insurance without repeated manual requests.
acceptance_criteria: A vendor portal flow exists for Tier A/B vendor onboarding with option to select a pricing bundle during signup
Automated SOC2 evidence handshake implemented via portal upload + secure S3 transfer + evidence metadata surfaced to Security team dashboard
Insurance credit calculation appears in procurement quote and can be toggled by Legal/Finance during review
Webhook + API documented for vendors to programmatically push questionnaire responses and artifacts
End-to-end test covering a mock vendor completing onboarding, uploading SOC2 artifact, receiving insurance credit, and contract generation exists
tasks: Draft vendor portal UX wireframes and minimal flows (PM + Design)
Define pricing bundles and crediting rules with Finance
Design SOC2 evidence schema and required metadata fields with Security
Build portal API endpoints and webhook handlers (ENG)
Integrate SSO for vendor accounts (SCIM + OIDC) and short-lived upload tokens
Add audit log hooks to Private control plane for on-prem evidence transfer
Create contract template with conditional insurance clause (Legal)
Run a 4-week pricing experiment with 30 vendors and measure time-to-sign and negotiation ask rate
decisions: Use a triage model: Tier A vendors get Legal-assisted onboarding; Tier B allowed self-serve if they provide SOC2 or equivalent evidence
Insurance credit is capped at 20% for newly onboarded vendors pending underwriting review
Evidence storage uses dedicated S3 bucket per customer with KMS encryption and short-lived signed URLs
Expose pricing bundle choices in the portal but hide advanced contract clauses behind 'Request Review' to prevent accidental commitments
open_questions: What minimum SOC2 reports are acceptable? Full Type II or attestation letters?
Do we require vendors to re-submit evidence on major infra changes, and how often should revalidation run?
How do we model insurance crediting for vendors who already have existing cyber policies?
What SLAs do we commit to for evidence verification turnaround from Security and Legal?
risks: Manual review bottleneck in Legal could negate self-serve benefits
Incorrect insurance crediting may lead to revenue leakage
Weak evidence schema could result in non-compliance for regulated customers
Portal upload security bugs could expose sensitive vendor documents
